craft_notes: Sthāyin: eighteen names chanted. Rows: names roll then law. Read aloud: litany.

lines: One, ten, hundred, thousand, myriad, lakh, crore, ten-crore, hundred-crore, thousand-crore, lakh-crore, ten-lakh-crore, ocean, end, midst, half-highest —
so tenfold in rank, eighteen: the count-law.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ekaṃ daśa śataṃ sahasram ayutaṃ lakṣaṃ niyutaṃ koṭiḥ arbudaṃ vṛndaṃ kharvaṃ nikharvaṃ padmaṃ śaṅkuḥ samudram antyaṃ madhyam parārdham iti krameṇa daśaguṇitāni aṣṭādaśa iti gaṇitavidhiḥ
